rationale: A bounded pilot of 18 existing entities per locale covers two collections, eight topics, three need paths, and the five existing Atlas places. It expands the original Russian pilot across the five already supported non-English locales at the user's request; it adds no locales or resource translations.
translationPolicy: AI-assisted candidates remain draft until an identifiable person reviews each exact source-bound translation. Draft entries and aliases must not enter public discovery or Atlas output.
exclusions: Resource facts, access, eligibility, language, and authority claims
Atlas themes, geography, hierarchy, jurisdiction, and applicability
New resources, collections, topics, need paths, places, or locales
